summary: The page layout is mostly well-structured for the mobile viewport, but the open dropdown menu exhibits inconsistent item alignment.

issues.title: Inconsistent item alignment
issues.description: The item without an icon is left-aligned with sibling icon containers rather than their text baselines.
issues.evidence: 'Snap to grid' label is shifted left relative to labels with leading icons.
issues.suggestion: Add inset padding to iconless items to maintain consistent text alignment.
